deployments_detail.use: Industry-first AI autonomous petrochemical operations at Ruwais facility using Honeywell Experion Cognition to detect and prevent process disruptions

AI-powered autonomous control room for full-scale petrochemical operations at the Ruwais complex, using Honeywell Experion Cognition (agentic AI + machine learning) to detect anomalies, recommend/automate corrective actions and optimise production. Proof-of-concept completed in a live production environment (industry-first). [Honeywell (Experion Cognition)]
deployments_detail.value: PoC indicated up to 20% efficiency gains, ~20% reduction in downtime and up to 15% operating cost reduction; part of AIDT programme targeting $575M value in 2025

deployments_detail.use: Proof-of-concept for an AI-powered autonomous control room at the Ruwais facility with Yokogawa, using AI to analyse operational data, identify patterns and predict anomalies to enable faster corrective actions and reduce downtime. [Yokogawa Electric]
